adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `refreshAccessToken` now calls `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. In sync mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` and `credential.userId` truthy), `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the HTTP `Response` from the credential sync endpoint, not from Lark’s `/authen/v1/refresh_access_token`. Immediately after, the code still passes that `resp` into `handleLarkError<RefreshTokenResp>(resp, ...)`, which (by type/usage) expects Lark’s `{ code, data: {...} }` JSON envelope. The sync endpoint is documented in-code to return only access token and expiry, so this mismatch will cause parsing/validation errors or missing fields when later code expects `data.data.*` fields.
